newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S MATHOMO CAUTIONS FURTHER.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S MATHOMO CAUTIONS FURTHER.

text.p: South African black empowerment Mathomo Group Ltd retailer said on Monday that the company was still involved in talks which could affect its share price.
The company gave no further details but urged shareholders to exercise caution in share dealings until further notice.
Mathomo said on April 13 it had bought the entire issued share capital of Tonclin Investment Holdings (Pty) Ltd for 24.6 million rand.
Tonclin holds Eldons Group, a retailer and wholesaler of educational, commercial and general stationery.
